description:
Tecsound is a high-density, polymer-based asphalt-free synthetic soundproofing
membrane, which is visco-elastic and highly adaptable, providing good acoustic
insulation across different construction elements without increasing thickness.
Engineered for airborne noise insulation in vertical partitions, ceilings,
roofs, and machinery enclosures, it also dampens rain impact noise on metal
roofs and impact sound in floating floors. Distributed in Australia by DCTech,
it is available in standard, self-adhesive (SY), and composite felt (2FT)
configurations.

cold temperature resistant; flexible down to -20°C

behaviour compliant with Euroclass B, s2, d0

High elongation capacity and
adaptable to uneven surfaces

Damping of impact noise produced by atmospheric
agents on metal roofs

Ideal for airborne noise reduction in lightweight
partitions and ceilings

rag_summary:
DCTech Tecsound (Tecsound / Tecsound SY) is a high-density, visco-elastic
synthetic soundproofing membrane distributed in Australia by DCTech. Formulated
from asphalt-free polymers at 5.0 kg/m² (Tecsound 50, 2.5mm) and 7.0 kg/m²
(Tecsound 70 / SY 70, 3.5mm), it provides an Rw of up to 30 dB as a single layer
without adding significant wall or ceiling thickness. Available with a
self-adhesive backing (SY) or composite felt (2FT), it dampens airborne noise,
aircraft flyover rumble, and metal roof rain drumming across walls, ceilings,
floors, and building services. Rated Euroclass B, s2, d0, non-toxic, and
flexible down to -20°C, it is an advanced acoustic damping membrane for
high-performance building envelopes.

install:
Switch off electrical power at the main breaker before working in
wall or ceiling cavities

Choose batt width (430mm or 580mm) to match
stud/joist centres (450mm or 600mm)

Friction fit batts snugly between timber
or steel framing members ensuring no gaps or folds

Do not compress batts into
cavities narrower than nominal thickness

Cut batts neatly around electrical
boxes, wiring, and plumbing using a sharp insulation knife

For internal walls
between bedrooms, bathrooms, and media rooms, combine with acoustic plasterboard
for best results
Complete lining over insulation promptly after installation

rag_summary:
Fletcher Soundbreak is a high-density,
non-combustible glasswool acoustic insulation batt manufactured in Australia by
Fletcher Insulation. Coloured green for rapid on-site identification, it offers
ratings from R1.7 to R3.1 across 60mm to 110mm thicknesses to attenuate airborne
speech, entertainment, and street noise. Formulated from FBS-1 bio-soluble
glasswool with up to 80% recycled content, non-combustible to AS 1530.1, and
CodeMark certified (CM 30006), Soundbreak delivers lifetime acoustic and thermal
comfort in residential walls, ceilings, and mid-floors.

description:
Fletcher Pink Partition insulation is a lightweight to
medium-density glasswool insulation batt specifically designed for commercial
steel and timber framed partition walls and ceilings. Manufactured from FBS-1
bio-soluble glasswool with up to 80% recycled glass content, it delivers
tailored acoustic attenuation and thermal comfort across low- and high-rise
commercial fitouts, offices, healthcare, aged care, and multi-residential
projects. With densities ranging from 11 kg/m³ to 32 kg/m³ and thicknesses up
to 165mm (R1.2 to R3.5), it is non-combustible and maintains cavity firmness to
prevent slumping.

install:
Ensure framing studs are
erected and cavity spaces are dry and clear of debris

Select batt dimensions
matching stud width (450mm or 600mm)

Friction-fit Pink Partition batts snugly

Ensure batts butt tightly against top and

rag_summary:
Fletcher Pink
Partition is a commercial glasswool acoustic and thermal insulation range
manufactured in Australia by Fletcher Insulation for steel and timber stud
partitions and ceilings. Available in densities of 11, 14, 24, and 32 kg/m³ and
thicknesses from 50mm to 165mm (R1.2 to R3.5), it delivers customizable sound
transmission control (Rw / STC) across commercial offices, healthcare, aged
care, and educational institutions. Non-combustible to AS 1530.1, CodeMark
certified (CM 30006), and containing up to 80% recycled glass, Pink Partition
maintains rigid friction-fit cavity stability backed by a 50-year commercial
warranty.
